Element.attribute: A unique end-to-end hybrid agile approach for implementing Oracle services at a client organization that is based on the EY Accelerate (EYA) methodology. The detailed work breakdown structure in this method showcases a traditional, sequentially phased waterfall approach that incorporates a set of business process-driven, agile-like progressive build cycles, which accelerate delivery and provide incremental value to the client.

Element.DisplayName: EY Oracle Services Normative Workforce Models
Element.Name: ey_oracle_services_normative_models
plan
Element.attribute: Kick off the project and define the project management plan (PMP). Review in-scope business capabilities with key client stakeholders. Facilitate security and controls workshops, develop the change management strategy and prepare for the upcoming fit-gap and technical workshops.

Element.Name: initiate_project
Element.attribute: Identify key client stakeholders and establish the core project team with representation from the client and EY. Additionally, develop the project charter and schedule and formally launch the project with the core team.

Element.Name: define_project_manage_plan
Element.attribute: Define the project governance structure, design authority and document the project management plan (PMP).

Element.Name: gather_information
Element.attribute: Review the request for proposal (RFP) and begin populating the requirements traceability matrix (RTM). Gather any additional information needed to better understand the client's current and desired business capabilities and supporting processes.

Element.Name: confirm_target_bus_capab
Element.attribute: Meet with key client stakeholders to confirm the business capabilities that will be part of the future state. Begin identifying the out-of-the-box Oracle process flows and EY pre-solutioned assets needed to enable the in-scope capabilities.

Element.Name: prepare_fit_gap_workshops
Element.attribute: Based on the in-scope business capabilities, schedule workshops with key client stakeholders to analyze whether the associated out-of-the-box Oracle business process flows meet the requirements of the business.

Element.Name: conduct_oracle_trusted_workshops
Element.attribute: Prepare for and conduct Oracle Trusted workshops with key client stakeholders to highlight any risks that could arise from failures around security and controls.

Element.Name: define_vision_case_change
Element.DisplayName: Define Vision and Case for Change
Element.attribute: Define Vision and Case for Change

Define a compelling future state vision for the Oracle services implementation and clearly articulate the reasons for the transformation in a way that resonates with those impacted and helps generate understanding and buy-in.

Element.Name: develop_viz_case_for_chng
Element.DisplayName: Define change vision and case for change

Element.Name: fin_change_vision_case_change
Element.DisplayName: Finalize change vision and case for change

Element.Name: define_chang_manag_stra_plan
Element.DisplayName: Define Change Management Strategy and Plan
Element.attribute: Define Change Management Strategy and Plan

Create an overarching strategy for organizational change management and training that focuses on maximizing the effectiveness of the Oracle services implementation through business engagement, readiness and adoption.

Element.Name: dev_bus_eng_ready_strat
Element.DisplayName: Develop business engagement, readiness and adoption strategy

Element.Name: construct_comp_bus_chng_plan
Element.DisplayName: Construct components of business change plan

Element.Name: fin_org_change_mgmt_strat_plan
Element.DisplayName: Finalize organizational change management strategy and plan

Element.Name: prep_tech_workshops
Element.attribute: Schedule workshops with key client stakeholders to discuss technical architecture, integrations, development and data conversion.

Element.Name: confirm_and_design
Element.attribute: Define business requirements, map process flows and facilitate fit-gap workshops. Define technology and testing strategies. Develop the master configuration workbook, RICEFW inventory and prepare for progressive build cycles.

Element.Name: define_business_requirements
Element.attribute: Gather future state business requirements from key client stakeholders based on the in-scope business capabilities.

Element.Name: define_mstr_bus_proc_inv
Element.attribute: Confirm with key client stakeholders the complete set of out-of-the-box Oracle business processes and any EY pre-solutioned process assets that will be included in the target state and identify client process owners.

Element.Name: map_rqmt_bus_process
Element.DisplayName: Map requirements to business process flows

Element.Name: conduct_fit_gap_workshops
Element.attribute: During each of the fit gap workshop sessions, walk the client stakeholders through the Oracle standard (out-of-the-box base) process flows as well as EY's pre-solutioned business process assets and determine their fit to the client's requirements.

Element.Name: review_base_proc_flows_assets
Element.DisplayName: Review base process flows and assets

Element.Name: review_rqmt_map_base_proc
Element.DisplayName: Review requirements and mapping to base processes

Element.Name: conduct_bus_proc_elab_ws
Element.attribute: For requirements that are a partial fit or no fit to Oracle's standard process flows and EY's pre-solutioned assets, conduct process elaboration workshops to further analyze the gaps, discuss alternatives and finalize next steps.

Element.Name: design_security_controls
Element.attribute: Mark potential risks in to-be (future state) business process flows and begin identifying relevant controls for these risks. Identify the roles and users in the target state Oracle platform and define the security and controls design specifications.

Element.Name: doc_sec_ctrls_design_specs
Element.DisplayName: Document security and controls design specifications

Element.Name: fin_sec_controls_design_specs
Element.DisplayName: Finalize security and controls design specifications

Element.Name: create_mas_config_wb
Element.attribute: Define the configurations that are needed to enable the in-scope business processes in the target state and document any necessary steps, values and screenshots.

Element.Name: create_mas_eicefw_inv
Element.attribute: Inventory the RICEFW (reports, interfaces, conversions, extensions, forms and workflows) objects that need to be developed to enable the requirements that can not be met by standard out-of-the-box Oracle functionality or EY pre-solutioned business process assets.

Element.Name: define_ini_backlog_agile
Element.attribute: Define an initial backlog in order to better estimate the work effort and prepare for the progressive build cycles.

Element.Name: doc_def_done_ready
Element.DisplayName: Document the definitions of done and ready

Element.Name: document_repo_specfic
Element.attribute: For the in-scope reports, document the specifications needed to implement the reports in the future state. Include the relevant data sources and where possible, provide mock-ups.

Element.Name: document_func_design_spec
Element.attribute: For the in-scope RICEFW (reports, interfaces, conversions, extensions, forms and workflows) objects, document how the custom developed objects should function in the target state solution.

Element.Name: define_env_plan_spec_on_permis
Element.attribute: For on-premises implementations, define the environments and tools needed to support the implementation of the Oracle solution. Determine how many environments will be needed and when.

Element.Name: define_instance_strategy_cloud
Element.attribute: Document the strategy for the implementation of the target state cloud services model along with any key architectural decisions.

Element.Name: define_integration_strategy
Element.attribute: Conduct workshops with key stakeholders to analyze integrations needed to support desired functionality as well as any necessary external integrations and document the overall integration strategy.

Element.Name: design_target_state_arch
Element.attribute: Document architectural decisions and the integrated solution architecture.

Element.Name: define_data_conven_strat
Element.attribute: Conduct a workshop with key client stakeholders to define the data conversion strategy for the target state implementation effort.

Element.Name: doc_data_map_conv_spec
Element.DisplayName: Document Data Mapping and Conversion Specifications
Element.attribute: Document Data Mapping and Conversion Specifications
Understand the data flows, map data to processes and define the data conversion specifications.

Element.Name: map_src_sys_data_target_sys_data
Element.DisplayName: Map source system data fields to target

Element.Name: fin_data_conv_specs
Element.DisplayName: Finalize data mapping and conversion specifications

Element.Name: plan_prog_build_cycle
Element.attribute: Define the overall implementation plan as well as the release plan that details the configurations and RICEFW objects that will be completed in each build iteration (1-n). Additionally, define the iteration cadence and synchronization of work.

Element.Name: develop_test_strategy
Element.attribute: Provide direction for the overall testing effort, identify the environments that will be needed and define the process for tracking and addressing defects discovered throughout the testing effort.

Element.Name: establish_test_automation_framework
Element.attribute: Identify the specific test cases that can be automated and prepare the associated test scripts. Additionally, define the test data requirements and identify the environment(s) that will be used for automated testing.

Element.Name: conduct_chang_impact_analysis
Element.attribute: Assess the magnitude of impact the change will have on the organization's people, processes and technology.

Element.Name: dev_chg_imp_analysis_plan
Element.DisplayName: Develop detailed change impact analysis plan

Element.Name: conduct_designed_solution_cia
Element.DisplayName: Conduct designed solution change impact analysis

Element.Name: conduct_stakeholder_analysis
Element.attribute: Identify the stakeholders impacted by or critical to the success of the Oracle services implementation and analyze their level of influence and support as well as their unique needs and expectations.

Element.Name: define_stake_eng_commun_plan
Element.DisplayName: Define Stakeholder Engagement and Communications Plan
Element.attribute: Define Stakeholder Engagement and Communications Plan
Develop targeted stakeholder engagement and communication plans for each group of impacted stakeholders in order to provide relevant messaging throughout the transformation journey.

Element.Name: fin_stakeholder_engmnt_comm_plan
Element.DisplayName: Finalize stakeholder engagement and communications plan

Element.Name: establish_chng_influ_net
Element.attribute: Identify individuals who will serve as advocates for the change and organize them into networks based on their levels and the business functions they represent.

Element.Name: define_training_stra_plan
Element.attribute: Determine the likely training needs of the stakeholders impacted by the change and create a strategy and plan to support the design, development and delivery of role-specific training modules that prepare end users and build profeciency before go-live.

Element.Name: progressive_build
Element.attribute: Iterate through the build cycles and drive business acceptance through incremental demos to key client stakeholders. Execute mock conversions and and prepare for system integration and user acceptance testing. Manage stakeholder engagement and communications around the change.

Element.Name: execute_build_cycles_1_n
Element.attribute: Iterate through the build cycles by planning for each sprint, defining the technical and integration specifications and data conversion scripts and completing the configurations and development. Validate the builds and conduct demos with the client.

Element.Name: perf_sprint_planning
Element.attribute: Define tasks for the upcoming iterations based on the backlog or RICEFW objects inventory.

Element.Name: doc_tech_design_specs
Element.attribute: Define the technical specifications needed to support the functional design along with the required batch processes and schedules.

Element.Name: design_app_batch
Element.DisplayName: Design application batch processing and scheduling

Element.Name: perform_configurations
Element.attribute: Complete the in-scope configurations needed to implement the target state Oracle solution.

Element.Name: develop_data_conv_scripts
Element.attribute: Develop the extract, transform and load (ETL) scripts per the scope of the build cycle and the data conversion specifications.

Element.Name: dev_etl_scripts
Element.DisplayName: Develop extract, transform and load scripts

Element.Name: perf_dev
Element.attribute: Develop the approved target state RICEFW objects per the tecnical design specifications and perform unit testing.

Element.Name: execute_validation_testing
Element.attribute: Plan, design, prepare for and execute end of cycle validation testing and address the defects.

Element.Name: plan_design_tests
Element.attribute: Plan for end of cycle validation testing and design test cases and scripts.

Element.Name: fin_vald_testing_plan_design
Element.DisplayName: Finalize validation testing plan and design

Element.Name: manage_defects
Element.attribute: Log and track defects based on the defect management process and standards.

Element.Name: conduct_iteration_demo
Element.attribute: Review and present incrementally completed builds to project stakeholders; capture feedback and sign-offs from key stakeholders for completion of work.

Element.Name: review_feedback_for_package_app
Element.DisplayName: Review feedback and incorporate into package application solution

Element.Name: execute_mock_conv
Element.attribute: Create the data conversion runbook in preparation for the mock conversion event. Execute the mock conversion as well as the defined roll-back plans and address any findings.

Element.Name: embed_security_controls
Element.attribute: Review the risk and controls matrix with key client stakeholders and build out the required security roles in the target state solution.

Element.Name: manage_backlog_depend_trace
Element.attribute: Throughout the implementation, actively manage the backlog. Document dependencies and govern traceability.

Element.Name: prepare_sit
Element.attribute: Plan for system integration testing (SIT) cycles 1 through n based on the test strategy and design the test scenarios, cases and scripts as well as the data requirements for conducting the tests.

Element.Name: plan_design_tests
Element.attribute: Plan, design and prepare for system integration testing (SIT).

Element.Name: prep_sit_data_env
Element.attribute: Prepare and load the test data and verify that the test environment has been set up per the specifications.

Element.Name: prepare_uat
Element.attribute: Define how business users can validate that the solution requirements meet user acceptance criteria.

Element.Name: plan_design_uat_tests
Element.attribute: Plan, design and prepare for user acceptance testing (UAT).

Element.Name: fin_uat_plan_design
Element.DisplayName: Finalize user acceptance testing plan and design

Element.Name: prep_uat_data_env
Element.attribute: Prepare and load the test data and verify that the test environment has been set up per the specifications.

Element.Name: manage_stake_eng_commn
Element.attribute: Develop and deliver consistent messaging throughout the transformation journey.

Element.Name: test
Element.attribute: Perform tests on the integrated Oracle services solution and prepare for cutover and deployment. Additionally, design and prepare training materials.

Element.Name: conduct_sit
Element.attribute: Perform system integration test (SIT) cycles 1 through n per the test strategy.

Element.Name: fin_sit_closure_report
Element.DisplayName: Finalize system integration testing closure report

Element.Name: conduct_conv_testing
Element.attribute: Design and execute data conversion tests.

Element.Name: conduct_regression_testing
Element.attribute: Optionally, perform tests to validate that any changes made have not introduced defects in previously tested code and configurations.

Element.Name: conduct_performance_testing
Element.attribute: Based on the agreed upon scope for performance testing, test the resource usage, speed, effectiveness, stability and scalability of the target state solution.

Element.Name: conduct_uat
Element.attribute: Prepare for and execute user acceptance testing (UAT) per the defined schedule.

Element.Name: prep_uat_data_env
Element.attribute: Prepare and load the test data and verify that the test environment has been set up per the specifications.

Element.Name: conduct_uat
Element.attribute: Confirm the list of business users who will perform the user acceptance testing (UAT) and conduct the tests.

Element.Name: fin_uat_closure_report
Element.DisplayName: Finalize user acceptance testing closure report

Element.Name: validate_segregation_duties
Element.attribute: Conduct a comprehensive segregation of duties (SoD) and senstive access (SA) analysis on the roles and user-role assignments in the target state Oracle platform and discuss any conflicts with key client stakeholders.

Element.Name: monitor_on_going_test_effort
Element.attribute: Monitor the overall progress of testing and capture and track defects based on defect management process and standards.

Element.Name: prepare_cutover_deployment
Element.attribute: Define the approach, plan and governance tasks to manage the transition of the target state Oracle solution into the production environment.

Element.Name: define_bus_cutover_approach
Element.DisplayName: Define business cutover and deployment approach

Element.attribute: Design the types of education, methods of development and collateral documentation for stakeholder enablement.

Element.Name: define_training_data_env_rqmts
Element.DisplayName: Define training data and environment requirements

Element.Name: prep_training
Element.attribute: Develop training and enablement collateral and plan logistics to deliver to impacted stakeholders.

Element.Name: deploy
Element.attribute: Deploy trainings to impacted stakeholders. Conduct data migration activities, confirm cutover readiness and perform the cutover.

Element.Name: deploy_training
Element.attribute: Support the delivery of virtual and instructor-led end-user trainings to impacted employees, track participation and evaluate the effectiveness of the training sessions.

Element.Name: perform_dress_rehearsal
Element.attribute: Prepare for and execute the data migration dress rehearsal and address any findings.

Element.Name: confirm_cutover_readiness
Element.attribute: Confirm that all essential elements are ready for go-live, including service management, production infrastructure, code and configurations, monitoring, data migration and end users, and role access.

Element.Name: review_cutover_plan_teams
Element.DisplayName: Review cutover plan with all stakeholders

Element.Name: perform_data_conv
Element.attribute: Identify and prepare the participants of the migration for the conversion event. Migrate the data, then manually remediate any data issues remaining in the target system after the migration.

Element.Name: add_data_conv_issues
Element.DisplayName: Address data conversion issues in target solution

Element.Name: perform_cutover
Element.attribute: Complete the activities required to transition to production.

Element.Name: verify_cutover_runbook_complete
Element.DisplayName: Verify cutover runbook items have been completed

Element.Name: support
Element.attribute: Provide post deployment testing support and provide refresher trainings as needed. Transition to operations and work closely with the client to get their sign-off on the completition of the project.

Element.attribute: Actively support the post-deployment hot fixes and warranty issues.

Element.Name: conduct_refresher_training
Element.attribute: Support the delivery of any end-user virtual and instructor-led refresher trainings that may be required post go-live.
